title: 3.3.8 Lab: Front-of-Line Queue
description: Use push and shift to move people through a queue, first in first out. Auto-graded: the code runs and the final line and the person served are checked.

steps.title: Start with the line
steps.instructions: The starter already creates the line: let line = ["ana", "bob"];. Leave that line exactly as it is. Ana is first, so she will be served first.

steps.title: Add someone to the back
steps.instructions: Use .push() to add one more name, "cy", onto the back of the line.

steps.title: Serve the first person
steps.instructions: Use .shift() to remove the first person from the line and store the returned value in a variable called served.

steps.title: Log who is served and the rest
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print who is being served (served), then console.log the remaining line array.

requirements.title: .push used on the line
requirements.description: Code calls .push( on an array, and the same array is later shifted. Help: 3.3.7 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
requirements.hint: Add to the back with line.push("cy") first, then take from the front with line.shift() on that same array.

requirements.title: .shift result is used
requirements.description: The value .shift() hands back is stored and logged (or logged directly). Help: 3.3.7 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
requirements.hint: line.shift() hands back the person it removes. Store it (let served = line.shift();) and print that variable.

requirements.title: console.log present
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.3.7 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
requirements.hint: Print with console.log: first who is served, then the remaining line.

requirements.title: line ends as bob, cy and served is ana
requirements.description: After the code runs, line holds "bob" then "cy" (cy joined the back, ana left the front) and served holds "ana". Help: 3.3.7 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
requirements.hint: push adds "cy" to the back, shift takes "ana" off the front. The variable must be called served, and line is left as bob, cy.

requirements.title: who is served and the rest are printed
requirements.description: The output shows ana (who was served) and the remaining line, bob and cy. Help: 3.3.7 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
requirements.hint: Print served and then line after the changes, so ana, bob and cy all show in the output.
